Emoji.ItsAnHonourToMeetYou: It's an honour to meet you.
Emoji.StandAndFight: It is better to stand and fight. If you run, you'll only die tired.
Emoji.SteppingForward: If you find your axe is too short, add to its length ... by stepping forward.
Emoji.OnlyForward: I demolish my bridges behind me - then there is no choice but forward!
Emoji.Childhood: Few are bold in old age that are cowardly in childhood.
Emoji.SharpSword: When men meet foes in fight, better is stout heart than sharp sword.
Emoji.WolfTeeth: Where Wolf's ears are, Wolf's teeth are near.
Emoji.FightFoes: Fight you foes in the field, nor be burnt in your house.
Emoji.FearNoDeath: Fear not death, for the hour of your doom is set and none may escape it.
Emoji.PrideKeepsPace: With many who come to power and honor, pride keeps pace with promotion.
Emoji.InTheSteath: Even in the sheath, the sword must be sharp - so, too, must the mind and spirit be within the body.
Emoji.TheThrall: The thrall alone takes instant vengeance; the coward never.
Emoji.CowardsWaits: Only a coward waits to be taken like a lamb from the fold or a fox from the trap.
Emoji.HoldTonque: No one is a total fool if he knows then to hold his tongue.
Emoji.InjusticeAndGreed: Ill it is to abandon honor and integrity in exchange for injustice and greed.
Emoji.ReachingSky: There is more honor in accumulating little by little than reaching for the sky and ending up flat on your face.
Emoji.PersonsActions: A person's actions are often worse than their intentions.
Emoji.Stubbornness: Stubbornness brings either great humiliation or great honor.
Emoji.GoWellAtFirst: It may go well at first, for those who try to lord it over others, but they may find things more difficult as time goes by.
Emoji.DeadWound: It often happens that he who gets a death wound yet avenges himself.
Emoji.Vengeance: The longer the vengeance is drawn out, the more satisfying it will be.
Emoji.HourOfAction: Short is the hour for acting, and long the hour for feasting.
Emoji.BeFree: Better it is to have a lower position in life and be free than to have a position of power only to be subject to the will of another.
Emoji.Troll: One should warn even a dim-witted troll if he sits naked by a fire.
Emoji.LiveLong: It may often be that those live long who are slain with words alone.
Emoji.HungryWolf: A hungry wolf is bound to wage a hard battle.
Emoji.ShortKnife: He with a short knife must try, try again.
Emoji.Sailcloth: Do not expect to make headway with a frail sailcloth.
Emoji.KingsPlace: The king’s palace is an easy place to enter but hard to leave.
Emoji.BadEnding: That which has a bad beginning, is likely to have a bad ending.
Emoji.Tyranny: All a people need in order to rise up against tyranny is a leader bold enough to take up the banner.
Emoji.NewShirts: Anybody who offends a more powerful man can hardly expect to wear out many more new shirts.
Emoji.WolfChild: Trust not him whose father, brother or other kin you have slain no matter how young he be, for often grows the wolf in the child.
Emoji.BurnedMan: The fire seems hottest to a burned man.
Emoji.Brotherless: Bare is the back of a brotherless man.
Emoji.OldDog: One should listen when an old dog barks.
